lens: geometry and proportion first, then materials and colour, then lighting on the seats, then artefacts. Measured against the official ANA photos y_47300-47306 (colours and finishes) and SANspotter NH7 2023 / fr57325 (geometry and unshown details). Scale: back width 0.43 m (17 in seat). Tools: PIL/numpy region stats (median hex, R/B, G/B, L10/50/90, Otsu light fraction), and local-contrast blob counts (scipy.ndimage). Scripts and crops are in /tmp/claude-0/raterB8/.

priorIssues.issue: w7a-1 / w7b-2 (high/medium): mosaic fabric too dark and violet, blurred dashes; a mosaic pad was darker than its back
priorIssues.evidence: Hue fixed: q15 seat 2 is #29355d, R/B 0.44, G/B 0.57 (was 0.31/0.43); y_47306 is 0.48/0.61. Still too dark: L50 47 against 63 (y_47306 right seat) and 80 (y_47300 seat 4 pan), and the 1 mm dashes average out at row distance: light/ground 2.48 against 4.85 in y_47306 (light #4a5c88 against #a0b0dd). The studio close-up (e4 pad wing) now reads correctly as columns of horizontal dashes. Pad against back: the mosaic pad wing is L 56 on a diamond back of L 61 (0.92; it was 0.78, and the photos give 1.0-1.35).

priorIssues.issue: w7a-2 / w7b-3 (medium): diamond is a regular grid of small plus-shaped stars
priorIssues.evidence: e4 / x_pillow / q15 seat 1: a broken diagonal lattice of mixed-size diamonds with dropped sites, so it no longer reads as wallpaper. The diamonds are still soft rounded blobs about 0.057 m across (40 px at 1.43 mm/px). The photos show 0.065 m (y_47302 middle seat) to 0.08 m (y_47306 left seat), with stepped edges and a tick-textured fill. q15 diamond L50 61 against 70 (y_47302); contrast 2.25 against 2.61.

priorIssues.issue: w7a-3 (medium): back rises only about 3 cm above the cover; slate fold visible above the hood from behind
priorIssues.evidence: e4 seat 2: back top 128 px, cover top 163 px, back 295 px wide, so 0.051 m (y_47306 0.053-0.073). q17 and x_backtop: no slate shows above the hood from behind. In q15 it measures 0.095 m because the camera sits higher than in y_47300 (vanishing point y 75 against 160) and sees the back's top surface. That belongs to camera placement.

priorIssues.issue: w7a-4 (medium): seat pans copy the back fabric
priorIssues.evidence: e1: fleck back with tick pan, fleck with tick, diamond with mosaic. econPan() now has its own hash, matching y_47300 (fleck/tick, tick/diamond, fleck/mosaic).

priorIssues.issue: w7a-5 (medium): petal fleck too dense and too fine
priorIssues.evidence: Blob counts (local-contrast threshold): q15 seat 4 gives 4921 /m2, median 38.9 mm2, cover 0.23. y_47300 seats 2 and 4 give 4855-4904 /m2, 37.7 mm2, 0.22. sans 13 gives 4252 /m2, 27 mm2. Fleck colour #596c94 on #141d46 (ratio 3.37) against #6c7aa0 on #132147 (3.63).

priorIssues.issue: w7b-1 (high): headrest pad invisible, no wing bolsters
priorIssues.evidence: e4 / q15 / q16: round wing bolsters stand proud of a recessed cover at both ends. In q15 each wing shows about 0.13 of the back width (y_47300 about 0.16). Remaining issues are listed as new w8b-2 and w8b-8.

priorIssues.issue: w7b-4 (medium): headrest cover navy, not slate
w7b (belt, from w5-w7): belt not teal

details.refs: q15 seat 3: L50 67, light 0.44, contrast 3.16. y_47300 seat 3: L50 69, light 0.52, contrast 3.06.
Size and density match y_47300 seats 2 and 4. The median is about 25 % dark: L50 37 against 47-53.
The close-up (e4) matches y_47306. At row distance it is darker and flatter (L50 47 against 63-80; contrast 2.48 against 4.85).
A broken lattice, but with soft round-edged diamonds about 0.057 m across. y_47306 left and y_47302 middle: 0.065-0.08 m, stepped edges.
Pans are now independent of the backs. Pads still follow a fixed rule: y_47300 seat 2 has a fleck back with a light mosaic pad.

Bolsters, recess and slate colour are right. The cover reads as a rigid tablet with a 4.6 cm box fold (q16 foreground), and from the side it floats as a separate card (e3). y_47301 / 47306: a thin, soft flap with a crisp fold.
x_pillow: soft, with a concave outline. Colour #202b4c against #242b4a (y_47300). Corners are less pinched than in the photos.
Proportions and pivot cap fit y_47302 / 47303. The studio render reads whiter (L 233 against 195), which is studio light.
The cushion crown, edge roll and front skirt match y_47302. Fabric mix is OK.
q17 / x_backtop / q18 against sans 15/22 and y_47305: the hood, rim and coat-hook knob are good. From the front and above, the white top cap is 3-4 times as thick as in y_47301.
q18 / e5 against y_47305: glass is 0.84 of the hood (photo 0.87); handset pod layout matches.

e6 against sans 20 / 22: one rigid black square-grid net, not two bowed black mesh pouches with a pleated grey hem and a centre strap under a light-grey lip. The safety card shows only a purple bar, with no white pictogram half. The AC socket and card colour are right.
e8 / e1 against y_47302 / 47303: legs, spreader bar, footrest paddles, life-vest saucer with red tab, SEB box.
q15 / q16 rows 4+: slate covers and pads stay visible, with no moire. Mosaic seats go uniformly dark.

issues.title: Dash mosaic still the darkest, flattest fabric at row distance (dashes too thin, so mipmaps grey them out)
issues.evidence: q15 seat 2: L50 47, light dashes #4a5c88 on #1a2349 (ratio 2.48). y_47306 right seat: L50 63, #a0b0dd on #142353 (4.85). y_47300 seat 4 pan: L50 80. y_47302 left seat: L50 110. Up close (e4 pad wing) the pattern is right. The 1 mm dashes on a 0.78 mm/px tile are 1-2 px thick and vanish by mip level 2-3.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py y_mosaic: dash thickness 2-3 px (1.5-2.3 mm), lengths 10-25 mm, dash cover 30 % -> about 40 % in the light cells, dash value near-white before colour-relative encoding. In 09_seats.js, yFabricC '#4a5576' -> about '#56638b'. Target: q15 L50 60-65, light/ground of 3.5 or more.

issues.title: Headrest cover reads as a rigid tablet: thick box fold and flat plate
issues.evidence: q16 foreground (crop /tmp/claude-0/raterB8/q16_fg.png): the fold shows as a rounded slab about 2-3 cm thick with box corners. In y_47301 foreground (p01_fg.png) the leatherette is a thin, soft sheet with a crisp fold line and a slight sag. The code has a fold gRBox(0.255, 0.016, 0.046, r 0.008) over a dead-flat plate gRBox(0.255, 0.19, 0.005).
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: replace the fold box with a thin bent strip (3-4 segments of 0.004-thick quads, or a gTube half-arc r 0.010) wrapping the pad top over about 0.025 depth. Bow the plate 3-4 mm forward at mid-height (split it into 3 slightly angled panels) and add a 1 mm lighter stitch line about 8 mm above the hem (y_47306).

issues.title: Seat-back pocket is a rigid black grid, not two bowed mesh pouches under a grey lip
issues.evidence: e6_lowback against sans 20 / 22 (NH7 2023): a soft light-grey leatherette lip spans the pocket. Below it hang two separate black mesh pouches with pleated grey elastic hems and a dark centre strap; they bulge outward. The safety card shows a purple header and a white pictogram half above the lip (no-smoking and no-device symbols). The render has one flat 14 x 4 black grid and only the purple bar.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js pocket: two net panels (each about 0.17 wide) bowed about 1 cm proud with a 12 mm grey (#8d9094) hem strip on top, plus a 2 cm dark strap between them. Lift the card 2-3 cm so its white pictogram half (atlas) shows above the lip.

issues.title: White shell cap on the back top too thick from the front and above
issues.evidence: q16 foreground: the white top band is about 15 px against about 30 px of fabric above the cover. y_47301 foreground: the white edge is 3-4 px; the fabric wraps over the top and only a thin rim shows. In q15 / q16 every row gets a bold white top outline.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js RS last rows: [0.869, 0.075, 0.06, 0.31] -> [0.869, 0.085, 0.04, 0.31], and pull the 0.855 row front back 1 cm, so the cap sits behind the fabric top. Or raise the fabric loft top SEC (0.862) by 5 mm.

issues.title: Fleck backs about 25 % too dark in the median, although fleck and ground colours match
issues.evidence: q15 seat 4: L50 37, mean #222d57. y_47300 seats 2 and 4: L50 47-53, #2a3860. Ground at L<p40 is the same (#141d46 against #132147), so the photo has lighter mid-tones (soft fleck halos and the weave).
issues.fix: make_swatches y_fleck: 1 px Gaussian halo round each petal at 30 % strength plus a faint vertical weave (amplitude 4 %). Or yFabricD '#424d70' -> '#4a5679'.

issues.title: Diamonds slightly small, soft-edged blobs
issues.evidence: x_pillow / e4: about 0.057 m across, with round blurred edges. y_47302 middle seat: about 0.065 m. y_47306 left seat: about 0.08 m. The real ones have stepped (staircase) edges with a fine tick texture inside.
issues.fix: make_swatches y_diamond: half-diagonals 0.035-0.05; quantise the edge to 4-5 mm steps (Manhattan distance on a 5 mm grid); modulate the fill with the y_tick tile at 40 %.

issues.title: Pad fabric follows a fixed back -> pad rule
issues.evidence: y_47300: seat 2 has a fleck back with a light mosaic pad (pad L50 93-96 against back 53); seat 4 has a fleck back with a fleck pad; seat 3 has a tick back with a fleck pad. Code HF maps fleck -> fleck every time, so no fleck seat gets the light pad that makes y_47300's headrests pop.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: choose HF with its own hash (as econPan does), excluding the back's own fabric except for fleck, for example fleck -> [mosaic, fleck][(k+n)%2].

issues.title: From the side the cover hangs as a separate card with slivers below the wings
issues.evidence: e3_side top (zoom: /tmp/claude-0/raterB8/e3_top.png): the plate edge shows as a thin grey line standing off the pad, with the hem a separate sliver below the wing ends (wings end at 0.585, plate at 0.585, hem at 0.572).
issues.fix: Tilt the plate's lower 4 cm back (-6 deg) so the hem touches the back fabric, or extend the centre pad panel down to 0.565 so the flap lies on it.

issues.title: (For the camera / lighting owner) q15 camera higher and pitched further down than y_47300
issues.evidence: Vanishing point at y 75 against 160 in y_47300. It shows the backs' top surfaces (rise above the cover reads 0.095 m) and crops the pillows and pans that dominate the photo's lower third.
issues.fix: test/qa.js q15: lower the eye about 0.25 m and level the pitch so the pans and pillows show as in y_47300.

questionsForUser: Headrest cover height varies between photos: y_47300 (level view) shows a cover about 0.165 m tall (aspect 1.45), while y_47306 / 47301 (from above) show 0.24 m or more. Is the leatherette flap height fixed, or does it look taller only because the 6-way headrest was raised? Any in-service photo taken level with the headrest would settle it.
Coat-hook knob side on the hood (modelled +x) is still unconfirmed. Is there a photo of the rear hood side?
Are the footrests in rows 31+ (per the reference) the hanging paddles modelled here, or a fold-down bar? No real photo in ref/web shows them deployed.
extraRefsSearched: No new downloads this round. Used the existing ref/web/econ set (sans 12-43, fr57325 x6): sans 13 (headrest / fleck at row distance), sans 20 / 22 (pocket, safety card, tray placard), sans 15 (hood). The official set was y_47300-47306.
